title: GUI contract tests spawn the real server binary
description: Vitest contract and smoke tests for the GUI start the real synap-server binary per test file (free port, temp cwd, auth required, known secrets), mint API keys via /auth/keys, and exercise src/services/api.ts and mounted views against it. Use node:http (not the DOM env fetch), avoid new URL(path, import.meta.url) (Vite asset rewrite in DOM envs), seed order-sensitive data sequentially, and assert configured secrets never come back.
